title: Your first agent
lead: Create a travel assistant that drafts an itinerary from your requirements.

sections.title: Prepare a Node.js project
sections.body:
In a separate Node.js project, install the core package with pnpm add @mastra/core. For this example, install tsx and TypeScript with pnpm add -D tsx typescript.
Set OPENAI_API_KEY in your server environment and run pnpm exec tsx agent.ts. Keep the key out of browser code.

sections.title: Read the configuration
sections.body:
id identifies the agent, and name is its display name. instructions set the task and response requirements; model selects the model.
generate() runs the task, and result.text contains its final text. You also need access to the selected model and sufficient account credit.

note: Add “Prioritize short walks for the older traveler” to instructions and run the same request again. Check whether the daily plan becomes less demanding. The wording may vary even when you leave the instructions unchanged.
